review.summary: The three verified transfers and final counts are correct: one macaw R3→L4 (five mixed birds, no clear); one orange R3→L1 (four birds); two red/yellow birds R3→R4 at the recorded outer-right perches. The far macaw remains alone on R3. No extra move, clear, score or win.

review.audio_review: AAC stereo stream confirmed. Original synthesized music, input taps, flutter and landing chirps; no narration. Audio was not listened to.
limitations: A deterministic still-image mockup, not recorded or playable gameplay.

review.visual_review: Opening closely matches the approved flat artwork, but the verified three-transfer loop fails. The first macaw lands on empty R4 rather than L4; orange birds duplicate onto several unrelated branches; the red/yellow pair changes identity and disappears instead of occupying the recorded outer-right R4 perches. Final R4 contains orange+macaw, while L4 and L1 remain effectively unchanged. Large white stars and rings spill into unrelated areas. Branch network and download footer remain broadly stable; the game state is unusable as a faithful demonstration.
